metadataRaw.description:
https://www.BestSpineCare.com

A common cause of lower back and sciatica  pain is from a lumbar ruptured disc or herniated disc. 

In this quick animated video, Dr. Rowe (St. Joseph, MI chiropractor) goes over what a lumbar disc herniation is, and how to treat it without surgery.
